messages:
elaine: CI blocked publish for @redwood/samplekit — typegen produced a regen diff and npm publish failed with 409.
mike: is this the "timestamp-only" churn we've seen before?
elaine: yes, changelog header changed: `## 1.4.4 - 2026-11-03T09:12:08Z` -> `2026-11-03T09:15:20Z`. generator uses wallclock in regen.
ci-bot: :x: publish failed for @redwood/samplekit@1.4.4 - 409 Conflict: version exists
toni: short term: set SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH in CI from commit timestamp and pass `--stable-timestamps` to the generator so builds are reproducible.
harry: also add a tiny pre-publish guard: after regen run `git diff --name-only` and for changed changelogs run a diff check that ignores single-line timestamp header changes. If only that changed, skip publish-block.
mike: agree. we should be conservative: detect only the exact header pattern `## <semver> - <timestamp>` and ensure no other hunks changed. log the detection clearly.
elaine: another fallout: our publish-bot retried auth while npm returned 409, and the sampleapp e2e harness then timed out because it expected a freshly published package. Two separate failures cascading.
toni: for publish-bot we should increase retry backoff and include deterministic jitter (seeded from commit SHA) so test timing is less brittle.
harry: can we add an integration test that runs regen twice in CI clean workspace and asserts no diffs if no changes? That would catch regressions in generator.
mike: yes — add that in the release pipeline. also add a unit test for the changelog generator flag.
elaine: plan: 1) hotfix CI env to set SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH and set generator flag 2) add pre-publish timestamp-diff guard script 3) tweak publish-bot retry/backoff 4) add regen-no-diff integration test 5) long term: change generator to rely on commit metadata and only stamp timestamps when content changed.
toni: i'll open PR for (1) + (4). harry take (2), mike take (3). i'll coordinate.
ci-bot: build logs: https://ci.example.com/build/2820001111/logs (artifact: packages/samplekit/CHANGELOG.diff)
elaine: thanks team. tagging @devex for visibility. :sparkles:
